title: polypodium excavatum var. loriforme
intro: Polypodium excavatum var. loriforme, commonly known as Chinese spleenwort, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium excavatum var. loriforme include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
